info.name: Cityzens
info.description:
REST APIs used by the Cityzens Flutter client.

**Auth:** Session token is sent in the JSON body as `tokenId` / `TokenId` (not `Authorization: Bearer`). Run **Auth** first to populate `tokenId`.

**Environments:** Import `Cityzens.Test` and `Cityzens.Live` and select one (`baseUrl` differs).

**Out of scope:** Firestore feature flags, payment WebViews (`billing.thecityschool.edu.pk`), and static attachment GETs under `MobileAppAttachments` / `MobileCircularAnnouncement`.

Source: `docs/API/Index.md` and `lib/services/**`.
